name: Fujimi (Nagano, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Fujimi town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a lozenge-shaped notch.
history: Municipal flag of Fujimi, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1963.

features.role: Fujimi town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a lozenge-shaped notch
